column1: What two costs of the transformer do most new architectures attack?
column2: Attention's cost grows with the square of the context length, and generation produces only one token per full pass.

column1: What is a mixture of experts?
column2: Many expert MLPs per block plus a router that sends each token to only a few, so total parameters grow while compute per token stays small.
Total: every weight the model holds. Active: the weights one token actually uses. Jamba: 52 billion total, 12 billion active.

column1: How does a state space model process a sequence?
column2: It squeezes the history into a fixed-size state, h = A·h + B·x, and reads out y = C·h. Each token costs the same however long the history.

column1: What did Mamba add to state space models?
column2: Input-dependent (selective) dynamics, so the model chooses what to remember and what to forget.

column1: Why do shipping models use SSM-attention hybrids?
column2: A fixed-size state cannot recall everything exactly; a few attention layers restore precise lookup while SSM layers keep long contexts cheap.

column1: How does a diffusion language model generate text?
column2: It starts with every position masked, predicts all of them in parallel, keeps the confident ones, and refines over a few passes.
LLaDA (research), Mercury from Inception Labs (first commercial-scale), and Google's experimental Gemini Diffusion.

column1: What makes a reasoning model different?
column2: It writes intermediate thinking before answering and is trained with reinforcement learning on problems whose answers can be checked.
A network with learnable functions on its connections instead of fixed activation functions on its neurons.

column1: Where does quantum machine learning stand?
column2: An active research area with variational quantum circuits; no practical advantage for large-scale learning has been shown yet.

column1: Split this dense model's 256 neurons into 8 experts and keep 2: how much output survives?
column2: About 35% grouped in order, about 50% grouped by which neurons fire together. Trained mixture-of-experts models specialise much more.
